sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:35 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Debrief with night shift regarding early morning status of the CBD.
Debrief completed, suiting and gearing up for deployment and patrols.
Noticed ops phone sitting at 11%, will stand by here until battery life is healthier.

Welfare check — all clear; standing by to show presence to morning commuters:
Check-in Skyworld Entertainment Center and Aotea Square — all clear.
Walkthrough Bledisdoe building alleyway behind Skyworld Entertainment Center — all clear.
Check-in Commercial Bay — full sweep, all clear.
Standing by to show presence to morning commuters and the public before moving to next checkpoint.
Response call from MacPac Queen Street regarding a suspicious female individual inside the store, assistance requested.
Arrived; the female was at the counter, left the items there, did not purchase and left with no quarrel.
Response call from Unichem Pharmacy Queen Street regarding smokers outside, assistance requested.
Arrived; the individuals had left the area.
Check-in Aotea Square — full sweep, all clear.

Tanuki Japanese Sake and Sushi Bar

Arrived and asked the individuals to move along, which they complied.
Check-in Corner of Wellesley Street East and Lorne St — all clear.
Welfare check on stores along Lorne Street towards High Street:
Direct call from management to notify businesses around Aotea train station of a small event today 4pm–7pm and a big event tomorrow expecting 15–20k people attending 6am–6pm.
Notified businesses around Aotea train station — all clear.
Returning to route; welfare check stores along High St — all clear:
Welfare check on stores along Lower High Street — all clear:

Check-in Commercial Bay — full sweep, all clear.
Response call from Unichem Pharmacy Queen Street regarding individuals bunched up near their store front, assistance requested to move them along.
Arrived and spoke to the individual, asked him to move to a more neutral spot, which he complied — slowly but surely moving.
Leaving response call and returning to routes.
Check-in Corner of Darby St and Queen St — all clear.
Sweep walkthrough Wilson Carpark Elliot Street.
Response call from Spec Savers — an individual has stolen glasses, assistance requested to track him down.
Tracked the individual's last-seen direction and retrieved the stolen items.
Lunch break completed, standing by for changeover to afternoon shift while remaining vigilant.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:00)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Debrief with morning shift; will gear up and commence welfare checks.
Debrief completed, geared up and commencing welfare checks; heading down Queen St.
Welfare check-in lower Queen St, High St, Freyburg and Chancery Sq and stores in the vicinity — no issues to report; continuing patrol.
Welfare sweep on Shortland St, Fort and Gore St complete — no issues to report; heading to Commercial Bay.
Welfare sweep on Fort St — clear, no issues; conducting sweep on Commercial Bay.
Commercial Bay sweep conducted and completed.
Heading to Te Waihorotiu train station.
Arrived at train station, standing by maintaining presence as public presence is heavy — no further issues.
Standing down from train station as public traffic has calmed down — no further issues; resuming patrol on upper Queen St.
Upper Queen St sweep complete — no issues to report on stores in the vicinity.
Welfare sweeps complete — no issues; standing by Queen St maintaining security presence.
Sweep Wyndham St — all clear; patrolling St Patricks Square.
Welfare check Albert Grocery — stopped by the store owners requesting assistance to move a vagrant along from the premises.
Vagrant has been moved along — no further issues; continuing patrol.
Full sweep St Patricks Square, Federal Square, Cathedral and Liston House — all clear.
Welfare check Federal Street — no issues.
Welfare check 77 Convenience Store — all clear; heading back onto Queen St maintaining security presence, no calls to report.
No issues to report; heading back to HQ to charge ops phone.
2nd guard arrived for changeover; commencing patrols upper Queen Street.

Full sweep Elliot St, Darby St, welfare check on all businesses in the area — all clear; patrolling up Victoria Street.

Standing down from Commercial Bay; received a response call from Snickel Lane regarding a male vagrant shouting inappropriate words at passersby, en route to location.
Arrived at location; the vagrant was nowhere to be seen. Approached by a member of the public who made the call advising the vagrant had already left; standing by at Snickel Lane.
Standing down from Snickel Lane; heading back to HQ to commence break and guard handover.
Arrived at headquarters, commencing 30-minute break and responding to any calls that occur.
Afternoon shift concluded, handing over to night shift.
